input.subject: Durrah Transport Co. onboarding: documents needed
input.body:
Dear Nora,

Thank you for your registration documents. To complete onboarding we need two items:

1. VAT certificate: the copy you sent expired on 2026-07-29. Please send a current copy.
2. Zakat certificate: we have not received this. Please send a valid copy.

Please reply to this email with the documents attached.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team
